# winui3-Microsoft.Windows.AI.MachineLearning

**IMPORTANT**: Packages in the `winui3-*` namespace cannot be used without the
Windows App Runtime. This has to be installed manually by the end user. Read the
[PyWinRT winui3 documentation](https://pywinrt.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api/winui3/index.html)
for more information.

Windows Runtime (WinRT) APIs for the `winui3-Microsoft.Windows.AI.MachineLearning` namespace.

This package provides the `winui3.microsoft.windows.ai.machinelearning` module.

The WinRT APIs in it are those of version 2.5.1 of the
`Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK` NuGet package.
